changeSet.author: levchenko
changeSet.sql: WITH author_parts AS ( SELECT id, regexp_split_to_array(btrim(author), '\s+') AS parts FROM books ) UPDATE books AS b SET author_last_name = CASE WHEN cardinality(p.parts) = 3 AND right(p.parts[1], 1) = '.' AND right(p.parts[2], 1) = '.' THEN p.parts[3] ELSE p.parts[1] END, author_first_name = CASE WHEN cardinality(p.parts) = 3 AND right(p.parts[1], 1) = '.' AND right(p.parts[2], 1) = '.' THEN p.parts[1] ELSE p.parts[2] END, author_patronymic = CASE WHEN cardinality(p.parts) = 3 AND right(p.parts[1], 1) = '.' AND right(p.parts[2], 1) = '.' THEN p.parts[2] ELSE nullif(array_to_string(p.parts[3:cardinality(p.parts)], ' '), '') END FROM author_parts AS p WHERE b.id = p.id;
